mr_title: Fix: Ensure fish completion handles multiline help strings correctly

expected_issues.title: Fish completion items split over several lines break completion
expected_issues.description:
Each fish completion item is now emitted as three newline-separated lines, but fish command substitution splits $response on newlines, so type, value and help arrive as separate items and completion breaks entirely.

The fish script iterates `for completion in $response`, where $response comes from a command substitution that already splits output on newlines. Using `\n` as the intra-item separator (and splitting again with `string split \n`) means each item is spread over three loop iterations: metadata[1] is never 'plain'/'dir' with the matching value, so no completion is offered. The item must stay on one line (e.g. `type,value<TAB>help` with newlines/tabs escaped in help).
